'''Meciar''' is an [[Aiel]] warrior from the [[Night Spear]] society. 

== Appearance ==
He is a bulky man and wears the red headband representing the People of the Dragon. 

== Activities ==
He is part of the attack force that confronts [[Rahvin]]'s forces in [[Caemlyn]].
